name: Paladin
description: Steel that prays, and is answered.

name: Vanguard
description: First through the door and first to see the trap.

name: Juggernaut
description: Armor with opinions and a maintenance schedule.

name: Revenant
description: Refuses to fall, and has stopped being asked to.

name: Arcane Archer
description: Every arrow arrives already having been somewhere else.

name: Trapper
description: The fight was over before either of you arrived.

name: Nightstalker
description: You will hear the bowstring. That is all you will hear.

name: Artificer
description: Magic, but with a parts list and a warranty.

name: Necromancer
description: Extremely popular with a very specific demographic.

name: Soulsmith
description: Fits ghosts with hardware. Nobody asked it to.

name: Battle Sage
description: Three answers to every question, all of them loud.

name: Warden
description: Holds ground, watches the treeline, repairs the fence.

name: Doomhunter
description: Tracks it, corners it, and outlasts it.

name: Runeforged
description: Hammered, enchanted, and then hammered again.

name: Death Knight
description: The oath outlived the knight who swore it.

name: Bonewright
description: Builds things out of what is left over.

name: Wayfinder
description: Has been everywhere and taken notes on all of it.

name: Veilstalker
description: Walks between, and hunts on both sides.

name: Grave Warden
description: Keeps the quiet places quiet.

name: Aethermancer
description: Treats the boundary between worlds as an engineering problem.
